name: TradingAgents
description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
one_liner: A team of AI 'analysts' (fundamentals, sentiment, technicals) that argue with each other and produce a stock trading recommendation, like a simulated research desk.
buyer: A quantitative trading hobbyist or small prop-trading shop that wants a research-augmentation tool to generate and stress-test trade ideas faster, not a fully automated black box.
business_use_cases: A finance content creator uses it to generate daily 'what the AI analysts think' commentary for a newsletter or YouTube channel.
A small prop desk uses it as a research assistant to pre-screen tickers before a human trader does deeper diligence.
A fintech educator builds a course around it teaching retail traders how multi-agent research pipelines work.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid daily newsletter summarizing the framework's multi-agent analysis on a curated watchlist.
Offer a hosted, API-key-free version for retail users who don't want to set up Python, billed per report generated.

steal_this: Launch a $10/month newsletter this weekend that runs this framework nightly on 10 popular tickers and emails a plain-English summary each morning — with a clear 'not financial advice' disclaimer.
